identity.welcomeMessage: Help us understand how everyday sleep relates to attention and wellbeing.

participantID.label: SONA ID
participantID.helpText: Use the numeric ID associated with your research participation account.

pages.title: Your sleep tells a story
pages.body: Daily check-ins and future Apple Health data will help the team study patterns over time.

pages.title: You stay in control
pages.body: With permission, configured Apple Health samples may be sent only to this study’s verified Study Backend. The central Control Backend receives no HealthKit data.

healthKit.rationale: With your permission, this study reads sleep analysis and resting heart rate. Local See My Data summaries stay on this device; configured samples may be sent to this study’s verified Study Backend.

notifications.rationale: Optional reminders can let you know when an Inoxity activity is available.

surveys.name: Morning check-in
surveys.description: A short reflection on last night’s sleep.
surveys.instructions: Open the secure external survey during its availability window.
surveys.privacyText: Inoxity does not read or store your survey responses.

media.instructions: Choose photos of your sleep environment when requested, then tap Upload to send them.
media.privacyText: Selected media is uploaded directly to this study's secure server and is not kept on this device afterward.

categories.description: Photos related to your sleep environment.

faqs.question: How is Apple Health data handled?
faqs.answer: Only configured types are read. Local See My Data summaries are not uploaded, while configured samples may be sent to this study’s verified Study Backend. Inoxity does not write to Apple Health, and deleted Apple Health samples are not yet mirrored remotely.

faqs.question: What if I forget a check-in?
faqs.answer: You can contact the Sleep Study Team for guidance.

completion.title: Thank you for taking part
completion.message: The study team will share completion guidance when your participation ends.
